changes: Add the missing shared chilli count-to-weight rule: one small chilli is estimated at 5g, including 小米椒 alias and 根/颗 units.
Existing canonical-unit forecasting now combines 5g plus one chilli into an estimated 10g without recipe reimport or history rewrite.
Reuse the same rule in stock conversion and cooking; retain existing estimate markers and independent manual shopping.

checks.regression: Exact and rough forecasts merge mixed-unit menu demand; legacy count-unit purchases retain their original quantities and history, deduct correctly and can be checked into rough inventory.

limitations: Default count weights are estimates, not measured product weights. Units without a known conversion are not added as if equivalent.
Isolated database and unit tests; no live model, production two-device sync or overwrite installation test.
